how.Text: How do I make alien armor?

hello.Text: Uncle Bazzit's! Solvents, human DNA, programming interfaces - everything a budding xeno-tailor needs.

how.Text: Analyzer on a Solid Clump makes Pristine or Mutated Bio-Material. My Nano-Solvent on that makes DNA-Soup, Essential Human DNA on the soup makes a DNA Cocktail. Atomic Re-Structuralizing Tool on Kyr'Ozch Viralbots wipes them, the Programming Interface formats them, and formatted viralbots on the cocktail make the Viralbot Solution. Pour that on Basic Fashion clothing, then add Lead Viralbots from the Generals. Viralbots must be at least 80% of the armor QL.
